title: Attributed empirical declarations and missing evidence
statement: Record only what the supplied scope attributes to the sandbox. No dataset was opened or analyzed in this work. Missing report, protocol and artifact bytes remain named obligations; a declaration or digest does not itself audit a result.
assumptions: Attribution is explicit; independent audit status remains unreviewed
Phase statuses are reported claims, not automatically verified facts
No result is promoted from an identifier or a page metadata prefix
No experiment, simulation, download or p-value reconstruction
boundary: The separate sandbox report was referenced but not supplied. The claimed lack of exposure and preregistration chronology are attribution, not independently checked history.
runtimeAPI: No new runtime export; these contracts and their native finite witnesses extend the admitted theory without duplicating the engine.
